page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; running head at top; page number at top right; signature at foot. No text in the margins.

main_text.p: Sed videamus, qualem praeterea esse oporteat Episcopum. Vigilantem esse vult, qui in omnibus suae functionis partibus advigilet, ne quicquam mali ecclesiae Christi sibi committi contingat, neve insidiator ille obrepat, ac de Christi castris quid intercipiat. Itē [?] Sobrium, vel potius temperantem, & sana mente praeditum. Est enim σωφροσύνη [?], sive σωτηρία [?] ἢ φρονήσεως [?], sive σώφρονα φρόνησις [?], integra & illaesa mentis constitutio, ne qua fit parte vel odio, vel invidentia, vel pravo aliquo studio, aut aliàs incurabili defectu intelligentiae ac judicii vitiata.
Modestum, vel compositū, bonis scil. moribus decoratum, qui & frugalibus atque decoris utatur vestibus.
Hospitalem, vel potius amantem hospitium, id est, qui hospites ac peregrinos amanter complectatur, & omnibus modis foveat.
Porro sobrietatem, modestiam & hospitalitatem etiam eos habere oportet, quibus praeest (quemadmodum Oecumenius annotavit.) Addidit ergo Apostolus, quod magistri proprium est:

Aptum ad docendum, qui videl.sciat quid, quibus, quatenus & quomodo docenda sint quelibet, ut scite ad usum populi accommodetur Dei verbum: quique non tantum artibus ad id necessariis sit excultus, sed etiam donum Dei tale habens, denique in hoc di-ligentiam adhibens.

page.notes: Signature reads "Dd z", an old form of 2; transcribed as "Dd 2" with doubt. Greek words are old type with ligatured sigma (printed like Ϛ), transcription of the Greek is uncertain and marked [?]. "Itē" is uncertain: the scan shows a word with a tilde, possibly "Item"; marked [?]. Small pen-like marks in the left margin next to "Modestum" and near the top of the text are not printed text and are omitted. The "I" of "Porro" is a printed initial. "videl.sciat" is printed with a stop after "videl" and is kept as printed. "quelibet" is printed with a q-ligature and is copied as "quelibet" without the expected "quaelibet". Hyphenation "di-ligentiam" is taken from the line break.
